lines.text: Passed or had a good time?
Many learners say: I passed a good time there.
Better: I had a good time there.
Had! We had a good time.

data.wrong: I passed a good time there.
data.right: I had a good time there.

native.tip: En español “pasé un buen rato”, pero en inglés “have a good time”, no “pass.”
